instagram.caption:
The good deal in the wrong size.
The Diaper and Care Backstock in the Nursery. Holds the reserve that feeds the changing station, in the sizes your baby is about to need rather than the ones on offer.

What done looks like:
1. One unopened pack of the current size
2. No more than two of the next size on a low shelf
3. Each size written large in marker on the short end
4. A wipes carton with its count visible

Free written steps for this zone, no signup: link in bio, or search 6S Success diaper and care backstock.
